scope: Three desk-verified dossiers; field proofs remain planned and ranking/routing remain fail-closed.

sources.supports: Design contract, cliff/ravine logic, esplanade, route and return to the city.
Project identity, spatial sequence, material and published visual saturation.
Adaptive-reuse authorship, building history and gallery/auditorium/library program.
July 2026 occupied exhibition use; event-specific, not future schedule evidence.
Original interdistrict mobility problem and cross-ravine connection contract.
Dimensions, glass section, traffic ravine and opening-period visitor behavior.

contradictions: The published architectural sequence establishes design intent but not current roof access or ordinary visitor density; verify both before routing.
composition_questions: Can one visitor's climb connect exhibition, concrete ravine and return view toward Lima without the caption supplying the memory metaphor?
Which horizon, railing or exhibition edge would split the visitor from the architectural sequence?
Does moving lower or farther back reveal the route more clearly than changing from 35 mm to 50 mm?

source_truth.answer: The active Ministry of Culture venue is the 2013 Barclay & Crousse building on the Miraflores cliff; its current August 2026 agenda confirms public cultural occupation.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The project reconstructs the coastal ravine as an approach, civic esplanade, exhibition ascent and roof-level return toward city and sea, using movement to prepare reflection.

current_life.answer: The building remains an active museum and cultural venue with exhibitions and programmed public activity in August 2026; the next event window must still be checked.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Credible verbs are approach, descend, enter, read, climb, pause and return; the strongest verb is climbing because the architecture turns bodily progression into the interpretive sequence.

architectural_causality.answer: The artificial ravine, ramp, terraces and roof path force the visitor through alternating compression, exposure and return; the route rather than the façade is the causal subject.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Published coverage is dominated by empty cliff-and-building hero views. The underrepresented family is an occupied ramp where exhibition, body and coastal section remain simultaneously legible.

light_material_geometry.answer: Diffuse garúa preserves concrete tonal steps and the continuity with the cliff; harder lateral light may clarify ramp depth but risks turning the museum into sculptural spectacle.

position_then_optics.answer: Test three positions: low in the entry fissure for compression, oblique beside the main ramp for layered ascent, and high on the return terrace for city re-entry. Choose 35 mm only when the route needs context; use 50 mm to isolate an aligned gesture.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Work during ordinary open cultural use, wait no more than 20 minutes for a solitary or paired ascent, avoid identifiable grief or sensitive testimony, and verify current photography and roof-access conditions on arrival.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The scene survives only if the viewer first reads a person being directed through a concrete ravine and then discovers exhibition and city/sea return; an empty award-building view fails the theme test.

A_STRUCTURE.exposure_intent: f/8, shutter for static architecture, ISO as required
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: No person required; fissure, ramp and upper opening must read
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Exclude parked vehicles, signs and clipped handrails
A_STRUCTURE.kill_trigger: Route reads as unrelated concrete planes
A_STRUCTURE.access_ethics: Remain in ordinary visitor area; do not block passage

B_HABITAR.position: Outside bend of principal visitor ramp
B_HABITAR.exposure_intent: f/5.6–8, at least 1/250 s for walking gesture
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Visitor climbs, pauses to read, then resumes ascent
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Keep exhibition edge and destination opening visible
B_HABITAR.wait_trigger: One visitor enters lower third while another level remains clear
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Avoid photographing sensitive testimony or distressed visitors

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Inside route looking across ramp rather than from canonical cliff overlook
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Cross-route movement interrupts empty hero geometry
C_ANTI_POSTAL.wait_trigger: Body overlaps ramp diagonal without merging with railing
C_ANTI_POSTAL.kill_trigger: Frame resembles published empty hero sequence

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: Close to board-marked concrete at a ramp turn
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Hand or shadow crosses material joint
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.light: Brief lateral sun or bright overcast
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Retain one spatial opening so detail implies whole
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.kill_trigger: Becomes abstract texture without architectural direction
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.fallback: Unoccupied shadow transition across wall and stair

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Upper return where ramp, visitor and Lima horizon can coexist
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Visitor exits interpretive route and turns back toward city
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.light: Late soft daylight before blue hour
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Horizon must not overpower visitor or route
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Turn or pause makes return legible
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Requires caption to connect museum and city
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Use only if terrace is ordinarily open and photography allowed

contradictions: A July 2026 exhibition proves recent occupation but cannot establish the next installation, quiet hours or unrestricted photography.
composition_questions: Can street, inherited casona and inserted cultural program read as three spatial lives before the history is explained?
Which doorway or exhibition panel must stay separated from the visitor for the depth sequence to survive?
Is the relationship clearer by stepping into alignment with the threshold or by widening the focal length?

source_truth.answer: The URP identifies the Miraflores casona, its university history and the 2004 Baracco–Bonilla restoration/adaptation as an operating cultural center.

original_spatial_contract.answer: A domestic casona became an early university site and later a gallery, auditorium and library; the retained house and inserted public program form the spatial contract to test.

current_life.answer: URP records active cultural functions and a July 2026 occupied exhibition; future program and normal visitor density remain visit-specific.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Enter, look, compare, cross, wait, read and converse are credible; crossing the threshold is strongest because it connects street, old house and current public use.

architectural_causality.answer: The retained entrance, domestic sequence and adapted gallery rooms channel visitors from Avenida Arequipa into cultural occupation; the threshold and depth sequence cause the story.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Institutional imagery favors clean rooms and event documentation. The less common relation is street-to-house-to-exhibition depth with an actual crossing gesture.

light_material_geometry.answer: Balanced exterior/interior light is more useful than dramatic illumination because wall thickness, doorway sequence and old/new junction must remain readable together.

position_then_optics.answer: Test outside across Avenida Arequipa for full threshold, just inside the entrance for reverse street connection, and oblique within the first gallery for old/new junction. Start at 50 mm; use 35 mm only if the street layer disappears.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Verify the active exhibition and photography conditions, observe for 15 minutes, avoid blocking the narrow threshold, and prefer back-facing or non-identifiable visitors during ordinary cultural use.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes only when the building's inherited domestic depth and present public occupation are both visible; a restored façade, empty room or isolated artwork fails.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Entrance axis from just inside property line
A_STRUCTURE.exposure_intent: f/8, bracket mentally but make one highlight-safe exposure
A_STRUCTURE.light: Soft morning exterior with interior lights on
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Keep door jambs complete and exclude traffic clutter
A_STRUCTURE.kill_trigger: Rooms collapse into one dark opening

B_HABITAR.expected_action: Visitor crosses inward while another looks deeper inside
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate both figures from door frames and artworks
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Prefer back-facing visitors; respect event rules
B_HABITAR.fallback: Single visitor crossing with artwork as second presence

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Side of entrance showing Avenida Arequipa edge and adapted interior
C_ANTI_POSTAL.expected_action: Street passerby and cultural visitor move in opposing depth planes
C_ANTI_POSTAL.wait_trigger: Street and interior gestures do not overlap
C_ANTI_POSTAL.kill_trigger: Reads as a heritage façade with incidental people
C_ANTI_POSTAL.fallback: Reverse view from gallery toward street

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.expected_action: Visitor shadow or hand passes junction without staging
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Include doorway depth so detail implies building
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.fallback: Empty light transition across wall thickness

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Threshold aligned through first cultural room
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: One arrival crosses while a second act of looking occurs deeper inside
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.light: Late afternoon before exterior falls too dark
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: Street, old shell and current program each retain a distinct plane
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.wait_trigger: Three layers read in one glance
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Use only during ordinary public access
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.fallback: Visitor leaving with cultural interior still visible

contradictions: Opening-period crowds prove possible behaviors but not normal-day density or present operating restrictions; direct verification remains mandatory before routing.
composition_questions: Can crossing and stopping appear as conflicting verbs caused by the same bridge geometry before the selfie context is explained?
Which railing, phone or traffic overlap would turn the scene back into spectacle?
Does a more distant position align fast and stopped users better than an 85 mm crop from nearby?

source_truth.answer: The 112 m pedestrian/cycle connection spans Armendáriz between Miraflores and Barranco; municipal sources establish its mobility purpose and completed public use.

original_spatial_contract.answer: The bridge was conceived to remove a long detour and connect two cliff-top pedestrian systems across a deep vehicular ravine.

current_life.answer: Opening evidence records walkers, cyclists, families, pets, skaters and people stopping at the transparent section; normal-day intensity is not yet proven.

human_verbs_or_meaningful_absence.answer: Cross, pedal, run, stop, look down and photograph are observed verbs. The decisive contradiction is fast crossing versus deliberate stopping over glass.

architectural_causality.answer: The long linear span enables uninterrupted crossing while the transparent deck and ravine view solicit stopping; two behaviors are produced by different parts of one object.

visual_forensic_saturation.answer: Opening crowds, centered symmetry, glass-floor reactions and sunset views dominate. A side-on section aligning a runner, stopped viewer and traffic below is the underrepresented relationship.

light_material_geometry.answer: Garúa suppresses the postcard coast and lets tubular structure, transparent deck and traffic channel separate tonally; hard noon light risks glare but may project useful shadows.

position_then_optics.answer: Test entrance oblique for flow split, side-on middle position for crossing/stopping, and distant cliff path for bridge-over-traffic section. Start at 50 mm; use 85 mm only from farther back to align verbs without changing their spatial relation.

moment_logistics_ethics.answer: Scout during ordinary morning use, remain outside moving lanes, cap waits at 20 minutes, avoid faces on the transparent deck, and verify current access or maintenance before committing the visit.

one_frame_contest_test.answer: The frame passes if the bridge visibly causes simultaneous transit and pause above the vehicular cut; it fails when the coast, engineering silhouette or selfie becomes the sole subject.

A_STRUCTURE.position: Distant cliff path with full span over Armendáriz
A_STRUCTURE.expected_action: Sparse users establish bridge function without dominating
A_STRUCTURE.edge_guards: Keep both landings and traffic channel visible
A_STRUCTURE.access_ethics: Stay on public path and away from road edge
A_STRUCTURE.fallback: Entrance oblique with both directions visible

B_HABITAR.position: Side of transparent section outside direct flow
B_HABITAR.expected_action: Runner crosses while another person stops and looks down
B_HABITAR.edge_guards: Separate bodies from tubular rails and phones from faces
B_HABITAR.wait_trigger: Fast and stopped verbs share frame
B_HABITAR.access_ethics: Do not obstruct lane or photograph identifiable reactions closely
B_HABITAR.fallback: Cyclist passing a stationary back-facing viewer

C_ANTI_POSTAL.position: Oblique side position including traffic below, excluding ocean horizon
C_ANTI_POSTAL.edge_guards: Exclude sunset, centered vanishing point and selfie pose
C_ANTI_POSTAL.wait_trigger: Vehicle and pedestrian directions oppose cleanly
C_ANTI_POSTAL.fallback: Tight bridge-deck/traffic section from legal overlook

D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.position: At junction of opaque and transparent deck
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.edge_guards: Include tubular frame and ravine depth
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.access_ethics: No staged pose or lane obstruction
D_LIGHT_MATERIAL.fallback: Shadow of passerby across deck transition

E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.position: Far enough along bridge to layer crossing, stopping and traffic
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.expected_action: Runner, stopped viewer and vehicle occupy three causal layers
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.light: Garúa or soft late afternoon without sunset color
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.edge_guards: All three layers separated; ocean omitted
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.kill_trigger: Any layer requires caption or merges visually
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.access_ethics: Public position, no obstruction, prefer non-identifiable figures
E_ONE_FRAME_STORY.fallback: Two-layer crossing/stopping frame with ravine geometry explicit
